<!--
This repository tracks its work in `docs/tickets/`, not in Issues.
An accepted request becomes a `FEAT` ticket, and the headings below are the ones that ticket wants filled in.
Writing them here means nobody has to rewrite the request to carry it across.
-->

## Title

<!-- One line, in the imperative, the way a ticket title reads. For example "Tree style CLI commands". -->

## Priority

<!-- 0 is most urgent and 4 is least. Be honest rather than optimistic. Most requests are a 2 or 3. -->

## The problem

<!-- What you are trying to do today, and where Docket gets in the way. Describe the situation rather than the solution. -->

## What you want

<!-- The feature itself. Say which surface it belongs to, the CLI, the MCP server, the config file, or the core library behind all three. -->

## Surfaces

<!--
The core library holds every rule and the CLI and MCP server are thin shells over it, which is what stops the two from disagreeing.
So a change to one usually has to appear on the other.
Say whether you expect that here, or why this one is genuinely single surface.
-->

## Alternatives

<!-- Anything you tried instead, and why it was not enough. A workaround that almost works is useful to know about. -->
